svg.title: Swipe right
svg.desc: Black hand and turquoise arrow. Reconstructed as cubic Bezier vector paths from all 37 source frames; native SVG animation at the original 25 frames per second.
svg.metadata: Source: swipe-right.mp4; canvas: 512x512; cycle: 1.48 seconds; 37 measured vector states; no raster content, scripts or external dependencies.
